memory.content: User owns/consults on an idle/incremental game and is pulled in by the team lead for decisions.
Prefer presentational-only VFX and cinematics as non-authoritative overlays: never gate rewards or transit commit on VFX finishing, and do not persist latch/pose/phase into saves.
Prefer extending existing manager phase hooks over adding a parallel cinematic or controller.

Balance retunes for kill pressure, scroll, and spawn density stay constants-only and local-client from on-screen standing counts; never guest/peer/session/save fields. Flag the team lead before widening craft into multiplayer or session surfaces.
